card.name: Cuban Rumba
card.profile: Cuban rumba is a secular Afro-Cuban genre of music, dance and song that originated in urban Havana and Matanzas in the late 19th century, rooted in African (Abakua, Yuka/Congo) and Spanish-derived (coros de clave) traditions. The rumba complex comprises three forms: yambu (slow, couple), guaguanco (couple, featuring the vacunao pelvic thrust), and columbia (fast, solo, male, acrobatic, linked to Abakua). Performed with tumbadoras, lead quinto, claves, palitos/cata and call-and-response vocals (English Wikipedia; UNESCO).
card.insight: 'Rumba in Cuba' was inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List in 2016 (file 01185); UNESCO notes it historically acted as an expression of self-esteem and resistance (UNESCO).
